lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
no i need to ask you some question first for my investigation
…I understand. Ask what you need, Detective. I'll answer what I can.

…22:00? But I— …Detective, I have to tell you the truth. I wasn't just passing by at midnight. I was on the bridge earlier… around 22:50. I heard a tiny, high-pitched bell ringing from under it. Then someone walked away along the riverbank… with a dark umbrella. I couldn't see their face… anything. I was so scared I hid in a bus shelter for almost an hour before I could make myself go down and look…
